card.line: Mount Nebo is a mountain in Moab, across from Jericho, where Moses saw the Promised Land from a distance and died.

moments.title: God Calls Moses Up
moments.text: The LORD told Moses to go up Mount Nebo and view Canaan, the land He was giving to Israel. He said Moses would die there, and would not enter the land because he and Aaron broke faith at Meribah-kadesh.

moments.title: Moses Sees the Land
moments.text: Moses went up to the top of Pisgah, and the LORD showed him the whole land. The LORD said this was the land He swore to give Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, but Moses would not cross into it.

moments.title: Moses Dies
moments.text: Moses the servant of the LORD died there in the land of Moab, just as the LORD had said.
